newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end at record high.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end at record high.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed at a record high on strong foreign bids that look set to continue propelling the booming bolsa, traders said.
The bourse's 19-share .IBC index closed up 2.63 percent at 9,365.15 points as 107 million shares traded, worth 12 billion bolivars ($25 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
"Going forward there could be some small corrections as in the day before yesterday, but otherwise the market still has room to grow," Intervalores broker Ricardo Merino said.
